ns2:course.label: Human Paleontology
ns2:course.description: (ANTH 340) Principles of evolution and a survey of human evolution from the early primates through the Pleistocene epoch; emphasis on evolutionary theory as applied to humans and interpretation of the fossil record. 3 undergraduate hours. 3 or 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: ANTH 220 or an introductory life sciences course, or consent of instructor.
